name: Diyala Gas Fields Supply Pipeline (Gilabat-Qumar / Khashim Ahmer-Injana)
monitor_reason: Fails add-threshold leg (c) as applied to a pipeline, and (b) is only partial. The concrete steps on record (20-year development contracts signed Feb 2023 and activated Oct-Dec 2023; 3D seismic phase 1 completed Apr 2025) are FIELD-development milestones, not a pipeline-specific step (no pipeline tender / FEED / EPC / route / FID). No distinct transmission pipeline is defined anywhere: the primary source commits only to generic 'pipelines and infrastructure to supply gas' to 'nearby power plants' with no route, length, diameter, or named endpoints, so it cannot be confirmed to be a distinct transmission line rather than field/plant-boundary supply infrastructure. Project is still in appraisal (seismic), and the 'first gas within 18 months' (mid-2024) target has slipped past April 2025.
researcher_notes: SPONSOR (leg a) MET: Crescent Petroleum (UAE; Crescent won these blocks in the 2018 5th licensing round, contracts re-signed/activated 2023). ENDPOINTS (leg b) PARTIAL: source = Gilabat-Qumar and Khashim Ahmer-Injana gas fields, Diyala Province; destination = 'nearby power plants' -- trade press (Petroleum Economist, 2024) names Mansuriyah power plant, ramping 120 -> up to 520 MMscfd feeding Mansuriyah plus other nearby Diyala stations. No pipeline route/length/diameter is published. VOLUMES are field production (initially 250 MMscfd, up to ~520 MMscfd), NOT a verified single-pipeline throughput. CONCRETE STEP (leg c) is field-level only. MATCH-TO-EXISTING re-checked against all 54 Iraq gas rows: no existing row covers a Crescent new-build from these Diyala fields. P4058 'Eastern Iraq Gas Pipeline' (operating, cap 350) is the pre-existing Iranian import corridor into Diyala/Baghdad, NOT this build -- not a match. CONFIDENCE: medium. Corroboration: Crescent primary PR (2023-02) + Argus (independent, 2023-02) + Crescent seismic PR (2025-04); Zawya is a reprint of the Crescent PR and does not count as independent. All four cited URLs verified HTTP 200 via url_verifier.py. RECOMMENDATION: monitor for a pipeline-specific milestone (defined route/endpoints, pipeline EPC/tender, or FID) before staging a new_row; re-check on the next annual pass given the field development is active.
